..Title
Resolution to Increase the Purchase Order with Lunghamer Ford, for Four Vehicles (Increase: $16,379.00, Total: $231,591.00) 
..Memorandum
On November 6th, 2025, City Council approved Resolution #R-25-401 which authorized the issuance of a purchase order in the amount of $215,212.00 to Lunghamer Ford, Owosso, Michigan for four vehicles under the MI Deal cooperative purchasing contract (#240000001208). 
On December 15th, 2025 Ford announced that they will no longer be manufacturing the Ford F-150 Lightning and that all pending orders will not be fulfilled. In resolution #R-25-401 two of the four vehicles authorized for purchase are F-150 Lightnings. Fleet was able to work with the sales team at Lunghamer Ford to locate two Lightnings on dealer lots in the nation that would be close to the specs we had on order. However, due to the options the vehicles came with from the manufacturer, the costs are higher. 
Additional funds in the amount of $16,379.00 are requested to make the purchases, bringing the amended purchase order total to $231,591.00.  
Budget/Fiscal Impact: Funding for this increase cost is available in the FY2026 Fleet Services Fund Operations and Maintenance budget as a pass-thru from the operating units.
..Staff
Prepared by:		CJ Stegink, Fleet Supervisor
                              Carl Konopaska, Fleet & Facilities Unit Manager
Reviewed by:		Mariah Walton, Deputy City Administrator
Approved by:  	Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, On November 6th, 2025 City Council approved Resolution #R-25-401 which authorized issuance of a purchase order in the amount of $215,212.00 to Lunghamer Ford, Owosso, Michigan for four vehicles

Whereas, Due to Ford discontinuing the F-150 Lightning and cancelling all orders, Fleet Service located two Lightings on dealer lots to make up for the two that got cancelled;

Whereas, The cost of the two Lightnings off the dealer lot are higher than the two trucks that were on order, 

Whereas, An additional amount of $16,379.00 is needed to amend the purchase order to address this deficiency;

Whereas, Lunghamer Ford complies with the City's Conflict of Interest and Non-Discrimination ordinance requirements; and

Whereas, Funding for this increase is available in the FY2026 Fleet Services Fund Operations and Maintenance budget; 

RESOLVED, That the City Council approve a $16,379.00 increase to the Lunghamer Ford purchase order #2025-510, for an amended total of $231,591.00; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take all necessary actions to implement this resolution.
